Answer: B
Reason: The frontal chest radiograph (Figure 1a) displays two distinct nodules indicated by blue arrows located in the lower lung zones (pulmonary bases). The nodule on the patient's right side obscures the right heart border, which is the definition of a silhouette sign indicating middle lobe location. The nodule on the left is positioned medially near the spine, consistent with a retrocardiac location (likely lingula or lower lobe), and the lateral view confirms posterior/basal positioning.
